BEACHFRONT

Bright beachfront island. Seaside sweepers. Hotel skyline. Tropical interior.

MEDIUM
Format
Circuit · continuous laps
Length
≈ 1.92 km
Unlock
400 trophies · Medium Tracks

Read the route

Seaside sweepers, resort buildings and an interior hairpin.

Find time

Keep the wide curves flowing, then change your rhythm for the tighter interior. Save enough road width to finish the hairpin facing the exit.

Practise here

Use the longer sweepers to build charge; spend it after the tight turn.

Try Sports Car and Racing lines.

Track goals

  • BEACHFRONT WINNER
  • BEACHFRONT SAFETY
  • BEACHFRONT DRIFT
  • BEACHFRONT FLOW
  • BEACHFRONT SPRINT

Exact requirements and trophy values: Achievements. Hidden discoveries are under its spoiler disclosure.
